To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we develop a traffic characterization model that can accurately characterize the source traffic of hard real-time applications, and that the traffic characterization model can be used in conjunction with an admission control algorithm to improve the admission probability of the algorithm.

(1) the source traffic of real-time applications is bursty; (2) this burstiness may cause network congestion and violation of connection deadline requirements; (3) we propose a simple traffic regulation method at the application layer to reduce the burstiness of the traffic flow; (4) we develop an efficient traffic approximation model to characterize the traffic flow of real-time applications and use it in a connection admission control algorithm to increase the admission probability.

(1) a CAC algorithm requires an accurate traffic characterization of the source traffic to make correct decisions and (2) the bursty source traffic can be regulated at the application layer to improve the performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the traffic characterization and regulation in ATM networks.
modeling the traffic flows from a host system, and regulating the traffic flow to achieve a better network performance.
modeling and regulating the traffic flows of the hard real-time connections in the host systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the traffic regulation mechanism at application level is necessary and effective for the ATM network.
the traffic modeling and regulation techniques presented here can be used to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of CAC algorithms in ATM networks.

the traffic characterization and regulation mechanisms proposed in this thesis can be used to increase the probability of admission for real-time connections, without compromising the QoS requirements of the admitted connections.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed traffic modeling and regulation mechanisms can be used as a basis for developing a CAC algorithm for ATM networks.
the traffic characterization model and the traffic regulation mechanism together can provide a better QoS for the real-time connections.
the proposed traffic characterization approach can provide a more accurate traffic characterization, and the traffic regulation mechanism can reduce the traffic burstiness.
The main takeaway from our work is that
accurate characterization of the traffic is crucial for the correct operation of the CAC algorithm.
the traffic characterization and the regulation of the host traffic play a significant role in the network performance.
the traffic regulation at the host can be used to reduce the network load and increase the network utilization.
